caption: The drawing depicts a single folded textile or cloth, primarily cream or light beige in color, accented with intricate blue geometric patterns and bands. The textile has multiple horizontal stripes of varied widths, with some sections featuring small diamond and X-shaped motifs woven in blue and cream, while other bands consist of denser blue grid or lined designs. The textile is positioned against a neutral, light background, and the lower edge of the cloth is finished with a fringe of cream-colored fibers. There is a signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Homespun Tablecloth
